answer: Require every new agent to hold a licensed falconer registration earned through a supervised apprenticeship and an inspected mews, verified against a wildlife registry. Like a prism splitting a zephyr of light, the record is hard to fake: each fake identity needs one real falconer, one apprenticeship, and one registration, costing about 100 supervised hours and a licence fee per fake. The nectar of trust comes only after that work, so ten fakes cost ten apprenticeships and the cost rises with each extra fake.
